event_summary: A paintbrush moves across a transparent sheet, contacts a red spot, and leaves a curved red smear on the sheet.
raw_event_description: A transparent rectangular sheet rests on a wooden tabletop with a small red circular spot near its upper central area. A paintbrush connected to a right-side holder moves from the right/front area over the sheet toward the red spot. The brush tip reaches and overlaps the red spot, after which the red spot becomes smeared into an elongated curved red mark. The brush continues moving away toward the right side while the curved red paint streak remains on the transparent sheet.

reasons: The transparent sheet, red spot, brush, and right-side holder are visible before the brush contacts the red spot.
The red spot is still compact and separate from the brush in the first frame.
